Ever sense someone walk in without seeing them?

Kevin Trudeau describes a party where your back is to the door. Someone comes in, you feel it, and you turn around to find a celebrity or a wealthy person.

Kevin explains it as essence. He says a big presence is so large that it fills the whole room, and everyone kind of feels it.

It is a vivid way to think about the energy people carry with them.

When did someone's presence last change a room for you?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Why the people around you shape how you think.

Kevin Trudeau shares a saying that your income tends to match the average of your five best friends. He says most people hear it and think they need new friends, because the wrong crowd will drag you down.

He reminds us what our parents said: hang around that crowd and you turn out like them. Kevin says if that is true in the negative, it is true in the positive too.

You can team up with people who have big dreams and want more out of life.

Who are the five people shaping you right now?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

What happens when two minds share one clear purpose.

Kevin Trudeau explains the mastermind. Your mind is yours and mine is mine, but when we come together in harmony with the same purpose, we create a separate, connected mind.

He says Henry Ford, J.P. Morgan, Andrew Carnegie and John D. Rockefeller called it the most powerful thing you can have to create wealth. Napoleon Hill wrote about it too.

Who could you build a third mind with?
